_comment: Agency hosting standard (CORE_CONTRACTS §25). githubOwner = the agency GitHub ORGANIZATION every client repo lives under (private). githubUser = the shared company login, used only where it is signed in on this machine; otherwise the person's own org-member login is used. githubTeam = the org team that gets push access to every client repo. vercelTeam = the Vercel scope projects are created in. buildMachine = the Vercel build machine every client project uses (standard; never turbo/enhanced — owner decision 2026-10-08, build speed does not change site speed). Change here, never in scripts. leadRouter = the ONE agency lead router every client form posts to (CORE_CONTRACTS §27; rgp-lead-router repo) and the Cloudflare account that holds it and the per-client Turnstile widgets. leadRouter.repo = where the router's GitHub workflows run (set up client, check leads, deploy); the agency keys are GitHub secrets there, never on a machine.
